title: Normalized closed-Hom and unary-Hom degree-zero comparison
statement: For the commutative condensed ring and free parameter of [def-sfb-free-parameter-evaluation-data], $A_P$ is flat. Normalize the natural isomorphism $D(A_P\otimes -)\cong A_P[0]\otimes^L-$ as follows: on any K-flat complex $K$, its inverse followed by termwise localization is the braiding $A_P[0]\otimes^L QK\to QK\otimes^L A_P[0]$, the canonical single-object tensor comparison $QK\otimes^L A_P[0]\cong Q(K\otimes A_P)$, and the localized ordinary braiding. There exists a unique such natural isomorphism. Define the isomorphism $R\mathcal Hom(A_P[0],-)\cong R(\mathcal Hom(A_P,-))$ by uniqueness of right adjoints using this normalized tensor isomorphism and the derived tensor-Hom adjunction. For an ordinary module $N$, define the source degree-zero identification $H^0(F(N[0]))\cong p_X^*\mathcal Hom(A_P,N)$ by this isomorphism, exact point pullback and the canonical $R^0=\mathcal Hom$ identification. Define the target identification $H^0(R\rho_*p_U^*N[0])\cong\rho_*p_U^*N$ by exact single-complex pullback and $R^0=\rho_*$. The underived evaluation map inserts the same universal generator and uses the ordinary strong tensorator and evaluation.

proof.text: Apply restriction_free_flat_comparison to the commutative monoid with underlying condensed ring R. Its represented-free-module finite-limit clause is exactly finite-limit preservation by tensorLeft A_P. Convert this to ObjectProperty.flat. This includes the empty profinite parameter and the zero ring.

A flat object F placed in degree zero is K-flat. For every complex K, the native K-flat-right tensor comparison identifies QK tensor F[0] with Q(K tensor F[0]); compose with the single-complex termwise tensor comparison. Naturality follows from naturality of the native tensor comparison and of the single-complex comparison. For K also K-flat, expanding the two definitions shows this is precisely QObjTensorSingleFunctorObjIso: both use the same localization lax tensorator. Compose with the derived braiding and the localized ordinary braiding to obtain a natural isomorphism on all complexes. Lift this isomorphism through DerivedCategory.Q and the exact tensor functor factorization. The lifting component formula proves the prescribed normalization.

For uniqueness, resolve Q.objPreimage Y by a K-flat complex K using exists_quasiIso_flat_kFlat. The localized resolution and the object-preimage comparison give QK isomorphic to Y. The normalization identifies the inverse components of any two candidates at QK after canceling the exact-functor factorization. Naturality along QK isomorphic to Y and cancellation identify their components at Y. Extensionality of natural transformations and isomorphisms proves uniqueness. All remaining definitions retain their given canonical compositions.
